classes.name: Hepatitis C direct-acting antivirals
classes.description: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (Epclusa and authorized generic), glecaprevir/pibrentasvir (Mavyret), ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (Harvoni and authorized generic), sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir (Vosevi), elbasvir/grazoprevir (Zepatier).
classes.plainDescription: An 8 to 12 week course of pills that cures hepatitis C.

preferredAgent.sig: No cirrhosis or compensated cirrhosis: 1 tablet once daily for 12 weeks. Decompensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh B or C): 1 tablet once daily plus weight-based ribavirin for 12 weeks (label).
preferredAgent.sigShort: 1 tab QD x12 wk (+ribavirin if decompensated)
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for 12 weeks; people with advanced liver scarring also take ribavirin.

records.verificationNote: Ledipasvir-sofosbuvir 90-400 mg generic read on PDF p.14 right column: Tier 1, PA and dispensing limit flags; no limited-distribution flag. It is the only Tier 1 HCV DAA on the list and is picked as the lowest-barrier product despite the PA. All other DAAs are Tier 4 with PA and limited distribution. Sig is standard label dosing for 8 to 12 weeks, not printed on the list. Zepatier (elbasvir-grazoprevir) is not printed; not recorded as excluded. Not a BOGL: no AB-rated generic is preferred over a brand. [Sonnet check 2026-11-02: pick changed from ledipasvir-sofosbuvir to generic sofosbuvir-velpatasvir 400-100 mg (PDF p.15 row visually confirmed: Tier 4, PA, dispensing limit, limited distribution) because it is the pangenotypic regimen a prescriber would write; ledipasvir-sofosbuvir (Tier 1, PA, dispensing limit, p.14) moved to paRequired. PA/step/dispensing columns confirmed on rendered pages 13-15, 32, 79, 127 for HIV, HCV, testosterone, antipsychotics, biologics: no column shift.]

records.verificationNote: Mavyret 100/40 mg tablet read on PDF p.42 (Tier 5, PA; no QL printed). Mavyret pellet pack also PA (p.42). Vosevi read on p.44 (Tier 5, PA). Epclusa (sofosbuvir-velpatasvir), Harvoni (ledipasvir-sofosbuvir) and Zepatier (elbasvir-grazoprevir) do not appear on this list; not called nonformulary. Mavyret chosen as the only DAA here with no generic and the common first-line pill for treatment-naive patients. Sig is standard label dosing; duration not printed. [Sonnet check 2026-11-02: pick and its tier/flags re-read in the cached PDF; the printed flags confirm coverage, so verified. Effective date 2026-01-20 matches the printed update date (record A uses the same).]
